description: Check a signed price quote you received from a seller: was it issued by Last Price, is it unaltered, and is it still valid. Pass its jws string. A quote that fails still answers: valid is false and reason says why (a forged signature, or expired, which still returns the claims). Public: needs no credential. It answers 501 while signed quotes are off on this deployment, and you can instead verify offline against the public keys at /.well-known/quote-keys.json.

jws.description: The jws value of the signed quote you were given.

name: verify_signed_quote
